# dsh-custom-theme

**Bring tweakcn themes into DeepSeek Harness.**
Paste a theme's CSS, get both a light and a dark pal

ette applied across the whole UI.
Ships with optional custom wallpaper (image / video, blur, dim, ti

nt) and an
Apple-style liquid-glass composer with a pointer-following specular highlight.
中文说明 · Install with an AI agent
> The image above is a **schematic illustration**, not a screenshot of the running app.
## What you get
| **Two palettes from one paste** | `:root { … }` → light, `:root.dark { … }` → dark. A single-palet

te theme gains a legible companion automatically. |
| **Whole-UI coverage** | 140–156 design tokens:
alias layer, specific surfaces, focus rings, radii, fonts, and 38 static colour ramps. Light and da

rk are delivered separately. |
| **Paste-safety** | Only CSS custom-property *declarations* are read
. Pasted content is never inserted as a stylesheet. `url()`, `@import`, `expression()`, `javascript:

`, braces and semicolons are rejected. |
| **Custom wallpaper** | Image or video, `blur` / `dim` / `
tint` sliders, optional local file (downscaled to 1920 px and re-encoded as JPEG before storage). |
| **Liquid glass** | Frosted composer with a white specular highlight that follows the pointer. The

element itself never scales or transforms. |
| **Offline, no telemetry** | Everything runs in the re
nderer. No network requests, no analytics, no account. |
### A deliberate non-feature

The plugin **does not** try to change how fast the model's text appears. DSH assembles
`assistant/li

ve-chunk` deltas into a string and hands the whole block to `MarkdownText`;
the only pacing in the c

lient is a triple `requestAnimationFrame` flush. A client plugin
has no per-chunk event, and a `Muta

tionObserver` only sees text *after* React commits it.
Rewriting the conversation renderer would dro

p the official Markdown, tool cards and
citation interactions, and break copy/paste.

What the plugin *does* guarantee is that it does not make it worse: with everything off
it injects *

*zero CSS, zero SVG filters and zero token overrides**. Glass and wallpaper
are strictly opt-in, so

a fresh install adds no per-frame compositing work to a live
stream. An earlier revision enabled an

SVG displacement filter by default; that was the
most likely cause of janky output in small text are
as and has been removed.
## Install
### Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with a CLI-managed profile (`web` by default). The **desktop** profile is
owned b

y the Electron app and refuses CLI installs — see the note below.
- Node.js ≥ 22 for development / r

ebuilding `client.js`. **Running the plugin needs no
build step**: the generated `client.js` is comm

ing `client.js`. **Running the plugin needs no
build step**: the generated `client.js` is committed.

## Compatibility
The parser is exercised against a matrix of real generator outputs, not just the happy path.
| Input | Example |

| tweakcn v4 `:root` / `.dark` | `--background: oklch(1 0 0);` |
| tweakcn v3 / legacy HSL triplets

8-digit hex | including negative hue and alpha |
| `:root`, `:host`, `html`, `body`, `[data-theme="d
ark"]`, `.dark`, `:is(.dark)`, grouped `:root, .dark` | plus `:not(.dark)` / `:root:not(.dark)` nega

tion |
| `@theme inline` font stacks (v0 exports) | real font lists preserved |
| shadcn registry it
em JSON, registry index JSON, bare `{ light, dark }` / `cssVars` | fenced JSON, BOM, prose-wrapped J

SON, top-level arrays |
| Markdown fences, surrounding prose, BOM, CRLF | stripped before parsing |
| Single-palette community exports | companion dark/light scheme derived from luminance |
`npm test` runs 97 unit tests plus six compatibility scripts:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The method behind each claim — which shipped DSH bundles were read, which selectors are
stable, what
the headless checks actually prove — is in docs/evidence.md.
## How it works
## Architecture
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Everything the test suite needs is committed: a plain `git clone` can run `npm test`
with no network

access and no extra research checkout. The fixture snapshots are
**fact data** (raw CSS variable va

lues and token names), not bundled upstream source
code — see `tests/fixtures/README.md`.

`client.js` is generated. Do not edit it by hand — `tests/core.test.mjs` re-builds it
**read-only, i

n memory** and compares byte-for-byte with the sources, so a hand edit fails
the suite without touch
ing the working tree.

The browser half is a `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` closure factory;
React is inje

cted by the factory parameter, and the theme service comes from Cordis
dependency injection (`inject
: ['slots', 'locale', 'theme']`).
## Known limitations

- Text **arrival rate** is owned by the model response and DSH's renderer; the plugin
cannot smooth

it (see *A deliberate non-feature* above).
- The wallpaper uses two translucent shell tokens. A few

DSH components paint directly
from static colour ramps; those stay opaque by design to keep code and

tables readable.
- With glass enabled and no `!important`, a future DSH release could introduce a
h

igher-specificity composer background rule that wins over the frosted layer. If that
happens, the fi

x is a more specific selector, not an `!important`.
- The bundled `client.js` is verified by headles

s-Chrome CSS-rule checks and a VM DOM
harness, not by a full visual pass over the live GUI.
